record_title: Sharp dispersive tails of the degenerate mKdV–Burgers shock
provenance: A source-specific sharpening of the monotone degenerate Oleinik shock profile in arXiv:2609.20591v1: the exact upstream spatial rate, the repeated-root threshold tail, and the first logarithmic correction to the downstream contact tail are derived from the travelling-wave ODE.
limitations: The theorem concerns the monotone degenerate shock connecting -2s to s under 36*kappa*s^2 <= mu^2. It does not cover oscillatory, nondegenerate, or undercompressive shocks, nor nonlinear convergence rates of time-dependent solutions. Translation changes tail amplitudes and constant terms but not the displayed exponents or logarithmic coefficients. The full text of Jacobs-McKinney-Shearer (1995), the closest older phase-plane reference, was not inspected, leaving residual originality risk for equivalent endpoint asymptotics under different terminology.
